parameter_policy: Reuse exactly the two predeclared candidates per family from v3; retune inside each outer training set. No wider search.

transforms.relative: E_P10_lux/(E_mean_lux+1 lux), inverse max(r_hat,0)*(max(expm1(mean_log_hat),0)+1 lux). The pair uses the same candidate; never held-room true mean.
transforms.asinh: asinh(E_P10_lux / 1 lux), inverse max(sinh(pred),0)*1 lux. Fixed 1 lux scale, not learned from held-out labels.

outer_validation: 7-fold LeaveOneGroupOut on TRAIN rooms: 6 fitting rooms, 1 scoring room; every hour and angle stays with its room
inner_validation: GroupKFold(3) on the six outer fitting rooms: 4 fitting rooms and 2 validation rooms per split
selection: For each family, feature set and target formulation: lowest unweighted mean of six inner validation-room MAEs in original lux. Exact ties follow candidate declaration order. No outer-label or TEST selection.
reuse: A/C share identical mean fits and predictions; B/D share identical mean fits and predictions. Mean, relative-P10 and asinh-P10 primitives reused within feature/family/candidate/split.

promotion_rule.comparison: B/C/D against A within the same family and target, using paired room errors
promotion_rule.meaning: Development screening per target, not an engineering acceptance threshold or independent final-test claim

scope: Development experiment on seven repeatedly used rooms. No new simulations, TEST operations, angle-policy optimization, full-seven-room deployment refit or integration. Geometry extraction and incidence features remain deferred.
provenance_limits: Geographic north and PVSD definitions unknown
